grain_rationale: dataset.row_count is 166158 and dataset.duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, so every row is already a distinct, non-duplicated record; a derived identity over flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, origin_airport, and dest_airport uniquely resolves each scheduled flight line (no single column reaches distinct_count==row_count, e.g. flight_number has distinct_count 2994 against 166158 rows), so the category is declared transaction-grained with no aggregation, and the zero duplicate_row_rate confirms the tuple need not absorb exact duplicates.

fields.name: flight_date
fields.description: The calendar date the flight operated, spanning 2013-01-01 through 2013-06-30 across 181 distinct dates with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: carrier_code
fields.description: The two-letter operating carrier code, one of 16 distinct values such as AA, DL, UA, and WN, with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: flight_number
fields.description: The carrier-assigned flight number ranging 1 to 8500 across 2994 distinct values; it labels a specific flight rather than measuring a quantity, so it is a dimension.

fields.name: origin_airport
fields.description: The origin airport IATA code, one of exactly 3 distinct values (EWR, JFK, LGA) with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: sched_dep_hhmm
fields.description: The scheduled departure time encoded as an hhmm integer ranging 500 to 2359 across 969 distinct values; it labels a point in time rather than a summable quantity.

fields.name: dest_airport
fields.description: The destination airport IATA code, one of 100 distinct values sampled as ABQ, ACK, ALB, and others, with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: tail_number
fields.description: The aircraft registration tail number across 3825 distinct values; nullable (null_rate 0.009154) likely where the operating aircraft could not be identified.

fields.name: is_cancelled
fields.description: A true/false flag with distinct_values [false, true] and null_rate 0.0 indicating whether the flight was cancelled.

fields.name: dep_hhmm
fields.description: The actual departure time as an hhmm integer ranging 1 to 2400; nullable (null_rate 0.029388), plausibly because cancelled or undeparted flights have no actual departure time.

fields.name: dep_delay_minutes
fields.description: Minutes of departure delay ranging -33 (early) to 1301 (late); a summable/averaged quantity across flights, nullable (null_rate 0.029388) for flights lacking an actual departure.

fields.name: arr_hhmm
fields.description: The actual arrival time as an hhmm integer ranging 1 to 2400; nullable (null_rate 0.0307), plausibly for flights that did not complete their arrival record.

fields.name: sched_arr_hhmm
fields.description: The scheduled arrival time as an hhmm integer ranging 1 to 2359 across 1134 distinct values, with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: arr_delay_minutes
fields.description: Minutes of arrival delay ranging -86 to 1272, a summable/averaged measure across flights; nullable (null_rate 0.032981) for flights without a recorded arrival.

fields.name: air_time_minutes
fields.description: Flight duration in minutes ranging 20 to 695, a summable/averaged measure; nullable (null_rate 0.032981), consistent with missing arrival data.

fields.name: distance_miles
fields.description: Great-circle distance flown in miles ranging 80 to 4983 across 203 distinct values, with null_rate 0.0; a summable measure across flights.

fields.name: sched_dep_hour_local
fields.description: The local scheduled departure hour, one of 19 distinct values from 5 to 23, with null_rate 0.0; a time-part label rather than a measured quantity.

fields.name: sched_dep_minute_local
fields.description: The local scheduled departure minute ranging 0 to 59 across 60 distinct values, with null_rate 0.0; a time-part label.

fields.name: departure_hour_utc
fields.description: The scheduled departure timestamp bucketed to the hour in UTC, ranging 2013-01-01T10:00:00 to 2013-07-01T03:00:00 across 3439 distinct hourly values with null_rate 0.0; chosen as the event time column since it is the only TIMESTAMP-typed column and resolves to hourly granularity.

fields.name: carrier_name
fields.description: The operating carrier's full legal name, one of 16 distinct values such as Delta Air Lines Inc. and Southwest Airlines Co., with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacturer
fields.description: The aircraft manufacturer name across 34 distinct values such as AIRBUS and BOEING; nullable (null_rate 0.160426) where tail_number did not match an aircraft registry record.

fields.name: aircraft_model
fields.description: The aircraft model across 121 distinct values such as 172E and 421C; nullable (null_rate 0.160426), matching the aircraft_manufacturer null pattern.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacture_year
fields.description: The year the aircraft was manufactured, ranging 1956 to 2013 across 46 distinct values; a label of the aircraft rather than a flight-level measure, nullable (null_rate 0.176531) where registry data is missing.

fields.name: aircraft_seat_count
fields.description: The aircraft's seat capacity ranging 2 to 450 across 47 distinct values; it describes the aircraft's fixed attribute rather than a per-flight measure, nullable (null_rate 0.160426) with the same registry-match gap.

fields.name: aircraft_engine_type
fields.description: The aircraft engine type, one of 6 distinct values such as Turbo-fan and Turbo-jet; nullable (null_rate 0.160426) matching the aircraft registry gap.

fields.name: origin_airport_name
fields.description: The origin airport's full name, one of exactly 3 distinct values (John F. Kennedy International Airport, LaGuardia Airport, Newark Liberty International Airport), with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: origin_municipality
fields.description: The origin airport's municipality, one of 2 distinct values (New York, Newark), with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: origin_elevation_ft
fields.description: The origin airport's elevation in feet, one of 3 distinct values (13, 18, 21), with null_rate 0.0; an airport attribute rather than a flight measure.

fields.name: origin_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: The origin airport's longest runway length in feet, one of 3 distinct values (7002, 11000, 14511), with null_rate 0.0; an airport attribute.

fields.name: dest_airport_name
fields.description: The destination airport's full name across 99 distinct values such as Boston Logan International Airport; nullable (null_rate 0.02089) alongside other destination-reference columns.

fields.name: dest_municipality
fields.description: The destination airport's municipality across 95 distinct values such as Atlanta and Austin; nullable (null_rate 0.02089).

fields.name: dest_iso_region
fields.description: The destination's ISO region code across 45 distinct values such as US-CA and US-FL; nullable (null_rate 0.02089).

fields.name: dest_elevation_ft
fields.description: The destination airport's elevation in feet ranging 3 to 6606 across 90 distinct values; an airport attribute, nullable (null_rate 0.02089) matching the other destination-reference gaps.

fields.name: dest_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: The destination airport's longest runway length in feet ranging 5076 to 16000 across 84 distinct values; an airport attribute, nullable (null_rate 0.02089).

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: A profiling/ingestion capture timestamp with only 16 distinct second-level values clustered around 2026-09-02T23:25-23:26, with null_rate 0.0; kept as a dimension since departure_hour_utc already serves as the event time.

category_description: One row represents a single scheduled flight departing from a New York-area airport (EWR, JFK, or LGA) during the first half of 2013, carrying its carrier and flight identifiers, scheduled and actual departure/arrival times, delay and duration measures, aircraft reference attributes, and origin/destination airport reference attributes.
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver_flights table enters the gold unified event star as the flights fact category, naming its time column, grain, degenerate identifier, and the role of every profiled field; it is an input exclusively consumed by the deterministic modeling engine that emits the gold models, never executed itself.
usage: The proposal is rendered deterministically into an ODCS mapping contract draft, validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, checked by a validator and `datacontract lint`, and then reviewed and approved or edited by a human before the modeling engine consumes it to generate gold models.
limitations: The mapping does not filter or exclude cancelled flights (is_cancelled, null_rate 0.0) nor resolve the roughly 3 percent null rates on dep_hhmm, dep_delay_minutes, arr_hhmm, arr_delay_minutes, and air_time_minutes, nor the roughly 16 to 18 percent null rates on aircraft_manufacturer, aircraft_model, aircraft_manufacture_year, aircraft_seat_count, and aircraft_engine_type where tail_number did not match a registry record, nor the roughly 2 percent null rate on destination reference columns; such exclusions, imputations, or enrichment are left to downstream consumers of the gold model.
